correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact reduction from raw received words to weight-one mismatch windows, proves the parent-collision criterion directly by comparing deleted strings, derives a sharp local packing bound, and gives an explicit all-parameter witness. The independent verifier reconstructs the channel literally and matches the theorem on 27 exhaustive parameter cases (7,829 received words), then checks 1,134 witness cases. Finite checks support but are not used to replace the all-parameter proof.
